newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1015 contrac.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1015 contrac.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1015 contracts, compared with 588 contracts traded overnight Tuesday.
There were 100 wheat, 411 corn, 360 soybean, 65 soymeal, 40 soyoil, two oat, four wheat call, 11 corn call, 11 corn put and 11 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 2-1/2 to 4-1/4 cents lower, corn was 3/4 to 1-1/4 lower, soybeans two to four cents lower, soyoil unchanged, soymeal $0.60 per ton lower and oats unchanged.
